question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **beckoning**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Beckoning** means to make a gesture with the hand, arm, or head to encourage or instruct someone to approach or follow.

 
 
• **Example -** *She was **beckoning** them in to shore.*
 
 
 
• ​Here in the given paragraph,** 'beckoning'** is used as a **verb** to describe a call or signal by a motion.
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate word is **'beckoning'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2.**

**Correct Paragraph:** *While I was sitting there (1) **sulking__** over my failure to keep from having to spend (2) **__my__** glistering summer months on the freaking Cote of Azur, Grandmere started (3) **__beckoning__** me from the phone. She kept (4)_________ her fingers on the phone to catch my attention. I just sat there blinking at her until finally, she put her hand over the receiver and (5)_________ (so that nobody listens), “Amelia! In my bedroom, there is something for you”. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Disconcerting** means making someone feel uncertain and uncomfortable or worried
 
• **Upsetting** means causing unhappiness, disappointment, or worry.
 
• **Dismissing** means to treat as unworthy of serious consideration.
